seo.title: The Audacity · Agentic Engineering Studio
seo.description: An Agentic Engineering Studio: AI agents build, senior judgment owns architecture, security and quality. Idea to deployed product in weeks. Book a call.

hero.headline: Your product live in weeks, at a fixed price
hero.lede: We build the whole product: sign-up and login, database, and launch on the web or app stores, with payments and analytics when you need them. The price and deadline go in the contract before any code, and you pay per finished milestone.

proofTeaser.title: Two products. Both ours. Both real.
proofTeaser.body: Instead of a wall of client logos, we point to two AI-first products we designed, built and shipped ourselves. The clearest proof we can offer is the work itself.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: We agree one outcome, a price and a deadline before any code is written.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: You see working software early and often. AI agents do the build; we make the decisions on architecture and security.

steps.title: Ship
steps.body: Your product goes live in production, ready for real users.

ctaBand.title: Have an idea that should already be in production?
ctaBand.body: Book a diagnostic call. We will tell you what it takes to ship it and whether we are the right studio to do it.

seo.title: Work · Bloop and Washiiba · The Audacity
seo.description: Two AI-first products designed, built and shipped in-house. Bloop, a conversational events concierge. Washiiba, a complete marketplace across mobile and web from one codebase.

hero.headline: Built on our own products first
hero.lede: Two products we designed, built and run ourselves, with the scope, the timeline and what each one shows.

cta.title: Want your product here next?
cta.body: Book a call and tell us what you want to ship.

seo.title: Book a call · The Audacity
seo.description: Book a diagnostic call, send a project brief, or join the waitlist. An Agentic Engineering Studio that ships products to production in weeks.

hero.headline: Book a call. Tell us what you want to ship.
hero.lede: Three ways in. Book a diagnostic call, send a project brief, or join the waitlist. Every message about a real project gets a human reply within one business day.

steps: A written fixed-price proposal within two business days.
Deposit, kickoff date, and the build starts.

booking.title: Book a diagnostic call
booking.body: Pick a time. We will talk through what you want to build, what it takes to ship it, and whether the Studio Sprint fits.

inquiry.title: Send a project brief
